sonnet.problem: The question says "Joseph says God meant it all to accomplish a day like this one." "It all" points back to the previous card's content, which is no longer on screen, so the question doesn't say who or what it covers.
sonnet.rule: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.
